# Royal Swiss City

> Royal Swiss City is a luxury gated community and residential development in Lahore, Pakistan, developed by Habib Rafiq. It features premium living spaces with world-class amenities, modern infrastructure, strategic location with easy access to major cities, and sustainable design built around the concept of riverfront luxury living.

Royal Swiss City represents a new standard in premium real estate development in Lahore, combining traditional luxury with modern urban planning. The community is designed for discerning buyers seeking exclusive properties in a secure, well-maintained environment with comprehensive amenities and infrastructure.

## Overview

- [Home Page](https://royalswisscity.com): Overview of Royal Swiss City with hero section and key highlights
- [The City](https://royalswisscity.com/the-city): Detailed information about community features, amenities, location benefits, and infrastructure
- [Developer](https://royalswisscity.com/developer): Information about Habib Rafiq, development expertise, and company history
- [Projects](https://royalswisscity.com/projects): Showcase of past and current projects by Habib Rafiq
- [Enquire](https://royalswisscity.com/enquire): Contact form for inquiries about properties and investment opportunities

## Key Information

- **Developer**: Habib Rafiq (60+ years in real estate development)
- **Location**: Lahore, Pakistan (with direct access to Motorway M1 and Kohat tunnel)
- **Project Type**: Luxury gated residential community
- **Key Features**: 40-foot roads, security systems, green spaces, water features, commercial plots, residential plots
- **Target Market**: Premium real estate buyers in Pakistan and abroad

## Features & Amenities

- [Aquatic Water Park](https://royalswisscity.com): State-of-the-art water recreation facility
- [Sports Complex](https://royalswisscity.com): Full sports facilities and recreational areas
- [Grand Jamia Mosque](https://royalswisscity.com): 70,000 capacity mosque with modern architecture
- [Green Energy Systems](https://royalswisscity.com): Sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy
- [Riverfront Living](https://royalswisscity.com): Premium waterfront properties and landscaping
- [Modern Infrastructure](https://royalswisscity.com): High-speed internet, utilities, modern roads
- [Community Amenities](https://royalswisscity.com/the-city): Parks, gardens, commercial zones, family facilities

## Strategic Location

- **Proximity to Major Cities**: Easy access to Islamabad (3 hours), Multan, Faisalabad
- **Transportation**: Direct M1 motorway access, Kohat tunnel for northern route
- **Urban Integration**: Located near Lahore Ring Road, premium areas
- **Connectivity**: Strategic position between commercial and residential zones
